messages.text:
"Create a 2D action tower defense game titled \"Jedi Temple Defense\" designed for mobile touchscreens with a dark, high-contrast minimalist aesthetic. it's whole theme is based on star wars

Visual Style and Layout:
- Background: Dark layout representing the Jedi Temple archives with blue glowing accents.
- Top Bar UI: Display Temple Health (100%), Force Energy (100%), Current Wave (1/5), and Score/Credits.
- Bottom Bar UI: Touch buttons for \"Shield Pylon\", \"Blaster Turret\", and \"Force Push\" (with cooldown visual).

Core Gameplay Loop:
1. Hero Control: The player controls a Jedi hero in the center of the arena. Tap anywhere on the screen to move the hero smoothly to that touch point.
2. Deflection System: Auto-deflect red blaster bolts when they enter a small radius around the hero, bouncing them back toward the nearest enemy.
3. Defense Placement: Tap to build structures along enemy paths using earned credits:
   - Shield Pylons: Slow enemy movement speed within range.
   - Blaster Turrets: Automatically target and fire cyan laser bolts at incoming droids.
4. Force Push Ability: Tapping the \"Force Push\" button releases an explosive wave around the hero, pushing enemies back and dealing area damage (10-second cooldown timer).
5. Waves @COMMENT_BODY@ Bosses:
   - 5 total waves of droids spawning from the left and right edges.
   - Wave 5 spawns a large Boss Droid with high HP and a red health bar.
   - Show a \"Wave Complete\" shop screen between waves to purchase movement speed and damage upgrades.

Win/Loss Conditions:
- Victory: Defeat all 5 waves. Show a \"Temple Preserved!\" victory screen with final score and a \"Play Again\" button.
- Defeat: If enemies reach the central archive node and reduce Temple Health to 0%, show a \"Temple Fallen\" game over screen with a \"Try Again\" button.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

content.text:
Built **Jedi Temple Defense** as a self-contained, mobile-friendly game in `index.html`.

Tap the arena to move the Jedi. To build, select **Shield Pylon** or **Blaster Turret**, then tap a placement spot. **Force Push** damages and knocks back nearby droids; red bolts are automatically deflected near the hero. Defend the archive through five waves and shop for upgrades between waves.

I used original canvas-drawn, Star Wars-inspired visuals with no external assets or dependencies. Verified the JavaScript syntax and tested building placement and Force Push in the browser. The mobile preview is saved at `screenshots/jedi-temple-mobile.jpg`.
